categories.evidence: CMakeLists.txt additions merely register the new fuzz utility source file as mechanical fallout of adding test code.
categories.rationale: Mechanical CMake modifications to link new fuzzing utility files do not constitute a build system change.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches the fuzzing test harness in `src/test/fuzz/fuzz.cpp` and adds a custom mutator utility in `src/test/fuzz/util/psbt.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Adds structure-aware mutation to reach deeper PSBT deserialization code paths that byte-level fuzzing cannot effectively exercise. The PR description notes that 'Byte-level mutations rarely produce well-formed key-value maps with valid keydata... so most inputs are rejected early and the deeper per-field parsing is rarely reached.' While it provides valuable fuzzing coverage and adds general custom mutator support to `FuzzTargetOptions`, it targets PSBT parsing rather than consensus or P2P attack surfaces and is reasonably deferrable.
